description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ZipStream PHP library, testing various functionalities such as adding files, handling exceptions, encoding, large files, and integration with PSR-7 streams.

classes.name: ZipStreamTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ZipStream library functionalities.

methods.name: testFileNotFoundException
methods.description: Tests that adding a non-existent file throws a FileNotFoundException.

methods.name: testFileNotReadableException
methods.description: Tests that adding a file with no read permissions throws a FileNotReadableException.

methods.name: testDostime
methods.description: Tests the protected dostime method for converting timestamps to DOS time.

methods.name: testAddFile
methods.description: Tests adding files to the ZIP archive and verifies their contents.

methods.name: testAddFileUtf8NameComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a UTF-8 name and comment, then verifies extraction and comments.

methods.name: testAddFileUtf8NameNonUtfComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a UTF-8 name and a non-UTF comment, verifying encoding handling.

methods.name: testAddFileNonUtf8NameUtfComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a non-UTF name and UTF comment, verifying encoding handling.

methods.name: testAddFileWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding a file with the STORE compression method.

methods.name: testDecompressFileWithMacUnarchiver
methods.description: Tests decompressing a zip with macOS Archive Utility, if available.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPath
methods.description: Tests adding files from filesystem paths and verifying their contents.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPathWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding files from paths with specific compression methods.

methods.name: testAddLargeFileFileFromPath
methods.description: Tests adding large files via file path with different compression and zip64 options.

methods.name: testAddFileFromStream
methods.description: Tests adding files from streams, including data from __FILE__.

methods.name: testAddFileFromStreamWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding stream data with different compression methods.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7Stream
methods.description: Tests adding files from a PSR-7 stream, such as a Response body.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7StreamWithOutputToPsr7Stream
methods.description: Tests adding PSR-7 streams to ZIP with output directed to another PSR-7 stream.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7StreamWithFileSizeSet
methods.description: Tests adding a PSR-7 stream with a specified file size.

methods.name: testCreateArchiveWithFlushOptionSet
methods.description: Tests output flushing option during archive creation.

methods.name: testCreateArchiveWithOutputBufferingOffAndFlushOptionSet
methods.description: Tests with output buffering turned off and then restored after archive creation.

methods.name: getTmpFileStream
methods.description: Helper method to create a temporary file and stream.

methods.name: validateAndExtractZip
methods.description: Helper method to extract and verify the content of a ZIP archive.

methods.name: getTmpDir
methods.description: Helper method to create and return a temporary directory.

methods.name: getRecursiveFileList
methods.description: Helper method to list all files recursively in a directory.

methods.name: addLargeFileFileFromPath
methods.description: Helper method to test adding large files via file path with various options.
